verdict.rationale: Oyster is an EOR and payroll platform, so payroll reporting is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only gives generic marketing lines about multi-country payroll and 'automated expenses, time-off, and reports'. Nothing documents payroll registers, gross-to-net reports, or any export of payroll reports for analysis.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can generate payroll registers and gross-to-net reports and export them for analysis
